# QueryRouter++

Multi-criteria LLM routing framework that selects the optimal model for each query using a formalized compatibility function C(q, m, w) = Σ wᵢ·Aᵢ(q, m) scored across four axes: performance, cost, latency, and ecological impact (CO₂). Weights live on the simplex Δ³ and shift toward performance when tools are active.

## Stack

- Python 3.11+
- FastAPI for the API server, Pydantic v2 for validation
- NumPy for scoring (no ML model at inference time)
- Poetry for dependency management

## Key Directories

- `src/queryrouter/core/` — featurizer, model registry, compatibility scorer, preference engine, router strategies
- `src/queryrouter/api/` — FastAPI app, request/response schemas, OpenAI-compatible proxy, LibreChat presets
- `src/queryrouter/data/` — CSV loaders and normalizers for the model matrices
- `src/queryrouter/evaluation/` — offline evaluator (accuracy vs oracle, cost, CO₂)
- `data_models/` — benchmark, cost and ecology CSV matrices (the model registry)
- `config/` — LibreChat presets (`presets.yaml`) and preference JSON schema
- `docs/` — architecture, quickstart, scoring reference, LibreChat integration
- `scripts/` — OpenAPI export, evaluation against a LibreChat conversation store
- `tests/` — pytest suite (coverage gate 80%)

## Running Locally

```bash
pip install poetry
poetry install

# Start API server (127.0.0.1:8000)
poetry run queryrouter

# Checks run by CI
poetry run ruff check .
poetry run ruff format --check .
poetry run mypy
poetry run pytest
```

Interactive API docs available at http://localhost:8000/docs after starting the server.

## Project Facts

- 12 model profiles across 7 providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral AI, Meta, Alibaba, DeepSeek) — source: `data_models/*.csv`
- Three routing strategies: direct (argmax of C), cascade (query-complexity threshold), embedding (cosine similarity on the heuristic feature vector)
- Grew out of an ENSAM master's thesis; the approach has since been applied to 600k+ production queries. Those production logs are not part of this repository.
